description: HoodKill is a top-down puzzle-stealth-action game about taking revenge on hooded cultists with a shotgun and careful planning. Hide behind a mask, observe patrols, lock doors to isolate targets, move lanterns into useful positions, then reveal yourself and survive the noisy attack phase.
intro: This guide focuses on the decisions behind a clean HoodKill route: reading patrols while disguised, controlling connected rooms, preparing traps, choosing the first target, and leaving enough time and distance for the shotgun reload.
guideTitle: HoodKill Walkthrough, Stealth Setup, and Shotgun Guide
guideIntro: The action phase is decided before the first shot. Use the mask phase to learn enemy movement and split the group so gunfire attracts only a manageable number of cultists from nearby rooms.
steps: Move with WASD while masked and observe every patrol before changing the room layout.
Use E to lock doors and isolate a target without cutting off your own escape route.
Pick up or drop lanterns with right click and place them where they support the planned trap or approach.
Remove the mask only after the rooms are prepared, then aim with the mouse and fire with left click.
Expect the shotgun to reload slowly and nearby enemies to hear each blast; create distance, use locked doors, and restart with R when the setup collapses.
